title: Dune
creator: Frank Herbert
description: A duke's son leads desert warriors against the galactic empire that destroyed his family, on a planet that is the only source of the most valuable substance in existence.

title: The Hobbit
creator: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A reluctant hobbit sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a group of dwarves to reclaim their treasure from the dragon Smaug.

title: Educated
creator: Tara Westover
description: A woman raised in a survivalist family in rural Idaho pursues formal education for the first time at seventeen, eventually earning a PhD from Cambridge.

title: Inception
creator: Christopher Nolan
description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into a target's subconscious.

title: The Matrix
creator: Lana and Lilly Wachowski
description: A computer hacker learns that the world he knows is a simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines that created it.

title: Spirited Away
creator: Hayao Miyazaki
description: During her family's move to a new home, a sullen young girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits.

title: The Dark Side of the Moon
creator: Pink Floyd
description: A concept album exploring conflict, greed, time, death, and mental illness, widely regarded as one of the greatest albums ever recorded.

title: Thriller
creator: Michael Jackson
description: The best-selling album of all time, blending pop, rock, and funk across nine tracks including the title single and its iconic short film.

title: Abbey Road
creator: The Beatles
description: The band's eleventh studio album, known for its continuous medley on side two and the iconic zebra-crossing cover photo.

title: Radiolab
creator: WNYC Studios
description: A show about curiosity, weaving science, philosophy, and human stories into hour-long investigations of big questions.

title: This American Life
creator: Ira Glass
description: A weekly public radio program and podcast built around a theme, with a mix of essays, short fiction, and documentary segments.

title: Do Schools Kill Creativity?
creator: Sir Ken Robinson
description: A TED Talk arguing that modern education systems suppress rather than nurture children's natural creativity.

title: Me at the zoo
creator: Jawed Karim
description: The first video ever uploaded to YouTube, an 18-second clip filmed at the San Diego Zoo.

title: National Geographic
creator: National Geographic Society
description: The official monthly magazine of the National Geographic Society, covering geography, science, history, and world culture.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
creator: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A sweeping narrated history of the human species, from the emergence of Homo sapiens to the present day.
